title: Full house

steps.say: This board is almost full. You'll finish it yourself, one move at a time.
Every row holds 1 to 9, once each. Tap this row's one gap.
steps.nudge: The gap is in the bright row.

steps.say: Which number is this row missing? Type it.
steps.nudge: Read along the row. Which of 1 to 9 isn't there yet?

steps.say: Columns follow the same rule. Fill this column's gap.
steps.nudge: Tap the gap, then type the number the column is missing.

steps.say: So do the 3×3 boxes. Fill this box's gap.
steps.nudge: Which of 1 to 9 is missing from the box?

steps.say: The last gap in a row, column or box is a full house. Only one number fits.
Pencil marks are notes. Tap Pencil to switch to notes.
steps.nudge: Pencil is the key at the bottom right.

steps.say: Notes are free thinking, never mistakes. Write a small 6 here.
steps.nudge: Tap the glowing cell, then press 6.

steps.say: Changed your mind? Press 6 again, or Erase, to rub it out.
steps.nudge: Select the cell, then press 6 or Erase.

steps.say: Tap Pencil again to go back to writing answers.
steps.nudge: Tap Pencil to turn notes off.

steps.say: Now a chain. This column has one gap left.
That left one gap in this row.

outro: Solved! When a row, column or box has one gap left, the missing number goes there.
